PZZ600-160300-
704 AM PDT Thu Oct 15 2026

.Synopsis for the southern California coast and Santa Barbara
Channel including the Channel Islands National Marine Sanctuary
and National Park...at 12Z or 5 AM PDT, a 1040 mb surface high was 
over northern Idaho with a thermal trough across the CA coast.
Strong north to northeasterly winds will create dangerous boating 
conditions today through Saturday, especially for the near shore 
waters between Ventura and Santa Monica.
